article.title: Amendment of Act 1 of 1872.
article.content:
92Amendment of Act 1 of 1872.

92. [Amendment of Act 1 of 1872.]—Omitted by Act 10 of 2009, s. 48 (w.e.f. 27-10-2009).
Note: this section had amended the Indian Evidence Act, 1872.
